name: LibriTTS
description: A corpus of approximately 585 hours of read English speech derived from the LibriSpeech audiobook collection, prepared for text-to-speech research with aligned speech and text.
citation: Zen, H., Dang, V., Clark, R., et al. (2019). LibriTTS: A Corpus Derived from LibriSpeech for Text-to-Speech. Interspeech 2019, 1526–1530. https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2019-2441

license.notes: LibriTTS is distributed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International; this license name is not a standard SPDX identifier. The source audiobooks originate from LibriVox, so verify the rights and terms applying to individual recordings and included materials before redistribution or use.
